author: claude
description: Lighthouse(height=22, stripe_a, stripe_b, band=3, roof, glass) is an 11 x (height+12) x 11 red/white banded round tower: 2-thick radius-4 lower half, radius-3 upper half, one radius-2 shaft with a ladder on the north side, slit windows, a railed smooth-stone gallery, a yellow-glass lamp room with a sea lantern/glowstone core, red dome and lightning rod; south door at (5,1,9). RockIsland(radius, depth, seed) is a jagged mixed-stone pedestal. build(height, depth, seed) puts the lighthouse on a 15-wide rock islet; ground_level=depth, so place with y = one above the water surface in water about `depth` deep.
name: striped_lighthouse
title: Striped lighthouse on a rock islet
